answer: Fixed-pool dilution: the reward tide is fixed at 40,000 credits, split by work, not headcount. Each identity posts a 40-credit bond, locked 20 epochs, plus a key-signed work proof. Hollow identities earn nothing without work; relic ones idle this epoch drop out. The same compute earns the same total from 1 or 1,000: 1,000 hollow shells lock 40,000 credits for nothing; rented work pays its true key. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep their share.
